archive.catalogue_description: Description This is an extremely hard map, but I know all you zombie beasts out there will be fine The theme is Choices, hence the name. In the beginning, your choices dont matter much. Such as: Choosing a door that will lead to the Geweryh or Carbine. But in the later parts of the map, this can drastically effect you, leading to dead ends and such. Your choices will ultimately decide if you are lucky enough to survive the zombie apocalypse!! death1 HAS BUY ABLE PPSH AND ENDING AND TELEPORTERS AND POWER UPS AND PAP AND STUFF AND TEXTURED PAPED GUNS! Dynamic lighting: colors and spotlights Power switch if you can get to it Buy Able Power Ups, Teleporter, etc Buy able PPSH brainfood1 dance1 Buy Able Ending Textured PaPed Guns (THIS WAS HARD TO GET A SCRNSHOT LOLOLOL) Beautiful Environment Beautiful Environment PaP Wooden Slats with Sun shining through Choices.. Decisions…

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3).
